info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Finance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Financial Statements Retrieval API facilitates access to detailed financial statements based on a specified parameter. This endpoint allows users, such as financial analysts and accountants, to retrieve pertinent financial data for specific entities or periods. It provides insights into an organization's financial performance and helps in auditing and compliance activities. Typical use cases include generating reports, analyzing trends, and informing strategic financial decisions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the financial statements using a unique identifier. It provides detailed information related to the specific financial statement, helping you analyze financial performance and make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve financial statements for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the required parameters are included in the request to receive the accurate data in response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the financial statement data.
